title: X-Runtime exposes per-request processing time
description: The response carries the Rails-style X-Runtime header, a per-request processing duration. It fingerprints the framework without authentication and gives a timing oracle for every endpoint, so an attacker can compare responses to find which inputs reach expensive code paths.
remediation: Disable the X-Runtime header in production (`config.action_dispatch.return_only_request_media_type_on_content_type` era middleware, or an edge rule that strips it) and keep timing details in server-side metrics.
limitation: One header value. The check reports a numeric X-Runtime value; it does not attribute the timing to any component and it cannot tell a framework default from a hand-written header.
